card.name: Punctuation breaking up web page text
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as a period, dash or space at a seam between pieces of web text, like a citation ending, a headline separator, or a photo credit or news dateline.

modes.label: Dashes in headline lists
modes.description: A dash or space separating headlines in a 'most popular' link list.
modes.example: ULAR - HEALTH - Well: For a Better Smoothie, Just Add Chia - Well: The Scientific 7-Minute Workout <<->> Well: Can Statins Cut the Benefits

modes.label: Period ending a citation or caption
modes.description: A period closing a book listing, date or news caption before the next item starts.
